task.text:
[0] Increase of the median lifespan in males by 40% (with overexpression of mei-9 (XPF homologue) was observed. The GAL4-UAS system were used to activate the expression of DNA repair genes.

[1] Increase of the median lifespan in females by 10% (with overexpression of mei-9 (XPF homologue)) was observed. The expression level of DNA repair genes under the control of a ubiquitous constitutive driver da-GAL4 increased by 1.2–3.5 fold. This resulted in an increase of the median lifespan in males by 7–40% (with overexpression mei-9, ) and in females by 10–30%.

[2] Under the control of constitutive neurospecific driver 1407-GAL4, the expression level of mei-9 increased 36.5–50.5 fold in males and 11.5–30.5 fold in females, respectively. This resulted in a reduction of the median lifespan of males by 4–64%

[3] Control: Elav-GS>UAS-mei-9, -RU486. The relative expression levels of DNA repair genes under the control of conditional neurospecific driver Elav-GS increased 1.3–8.2 fold in the nervous tissue of imago males and 1.4–7 fold in The Elav-GS-driven overexpression resulted in increased median lifespan in males overexpressing mei-9 (28%), and slightly in females overexpressing mei-9 (1.5%).

[4] Under the control of the conditional ubiquitous driver Act5C-GS, the expression level of mei-9 was increased. Conditional ubiquitous activation of DNA repair genes resulted in a reduction of the median lifespan in male and female flies. Control: AS-mei-9/Act5C-GS, -RU486.

[5] Under the control of the conditional ubiquitous driver Act5C-GS, the expression level of mei-9 was increased. Conditional ubiquitous activation of DNA repair genes resulted in a reduction of the median lifespan in male and female flies. Control: AS-mei-9/Act5C-GS, -RU486. The median value in the table in the article is less than the 90th percentile - most likely an error - here the data is entered in ascending order.

[6] All the XPG (ERCC5) null C57BL/6 mice exhibited progeroid featureds and died before 4 weeks of age.

[7] All the XPG (ERCC5) null FVB/N mice exhibited progeroid features and died before 16 weeks of age.

[8] All the XPG (ERCC5) null C57BL/6 x FVB/N mice exhibited progeroid features and died before 18 weeks of age.

[9] Mice, expressing a version of XPG (ERCC5) lacking last 360 aminoacids, developed the Cockayne syndrome phenotype and died latest at 1 month of age.

Each numbered passage describes one lifespan experiment. For each, report three things using ONLY that passage:
  organism: the model organism studied, one lowercase word
  direction: exactly one of 'increases lifespan', 'decreases lifespan', or 'no change'
  method: how the gene was altered, e.g. gene knockout, overexpression, mutation, knockdown

Output one block per passage, in order, formatted exactly:
[0]
organism: ...
direction: ...
method: ...

Nothing else. If a passage does not state something, write 'unstated'.
